skill.name: shadcn-ui
skill.description: Guide for building accessible React and Next.js interfaces with shadcn/ui, Radix UI, Tailwind CSS, React Hook Form, and Zod.
skill.summary: Build accessible shadcn/ui interfaces with practical React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and form patterns.
skill.author: giuseppe-trisciuoglio

security_audit.summary: Static analysis produced many alerts because the skill is documentation-heavy and uses Markdown code fences, schema URLs, and example CLI commands. Most pattern matches are false positives, but the skill should improve trust guidance for remote registries and avoid insecure authentication placeholders.

remediation.issue: Registry authentication example accepts every token if copied unchanged.
remediation.suggestion: Replace the return true placeholder with a failing default or a complete token validation example before publishing.

remediation.issue: Remote registry install examples do not clearly state the trust boundary.
remediation.suggestion: Add guidance to review registry URLs, generated files, and target paths before running shadcn add commands from third-party sources.

remediation.issue: Examples show registry targets in hidden home-directory paths.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users that registry items targeting dotfiles or editor rule directories can affect tools outside the current project.

faq.question: Does this skill install shadcn/ui automatically?
